description: Shopee Indonesia Affiliate Open API product offer and commission reads, with signed App ID/Secret support. The requested storefront descriptions, gallery, SKU stock/prices, and review bodies/photos/pages are separate surfaces; the public item-detail XHR currently returns access-gate error 90309999, so those features remain explicitly unimplemented.

capabilities.title: Search Indonesia affiliate product offers by keyword with current price and rate fields
capabilities.blocker: No valid Shopee Affiliate App ID/Secret or API entitlement was available, so the signed productOfferV2 query returned no catalog business data. The unsigned control error code 10020 is not a live search result.

capabilities.title: Read an affiliate product by itemId and bind both response IDs to a canonical productLink
capabilities.blocker: Exact App ID signed query and itemId binding are contract-tested locally; an authenticated item lookup remains unverified without an authorized App ID/Secret.
capabilities.note: The two documented Shopee-ID product URL layouts are accepted only when both shopId and itemId match the returned node. Query and fragment tracking are stripped; affiliate redirect wrappers are rejected.

capabilities.title: Preserve product price ranges, local commission amount, and rate tiers without guessed scaling
capabilities.blocker: The official schema labels amounts as local currency but does not return a currency code or scaling example. Amounts remain raw strings with currency=null, candidate IDR, and currencyVerified=false until a real business response establishes units.

capabilities.title: Supply official Shopee Affiliate App ID and App Secret in process memory
capabilities.blocker: The Shopee Explorer uses App ID and Secret. No credentials were available. Credentials must be provided by a runtime secret channel and never saved in the repository or receipts.

capabilities.title: Keep Shopee shopper login cookies out of the signed affiliate API request
capabilities.blocker: The client sends no cookies, but the official Explorer includes browser credentials in its fetch. With no valid App ID/Secret, a successful cookie-free request could not be verified.

capabilities.title: Reach the observed public product-detail XHR without the Shopee traffic/access gate
capabilities.blocker: The observed GET /api/v4/pdp/get_pc returned an error-only JSON envelope (HTTP 200, error 90309999, no data). Exact cookie-free replay returned HTTP 403 with the same error and is_login=false. The UI fallback says login required, but the API flag does not establish normal account authentication as the cause; access-gate semantics remain unknown.

capabilities.title: Sign in, enroll in an affiliate program, create links, modify carts, or place orders
capabilities.applicabilityReason: The requested Shopee subtask covers read-only product and price collection. Account signup, affiliate enrollment, link creation, cart, purchase, seller, and order actions are outside the authorized scope.

capabilities.title: Read full item description and product media from a current Shopee-ID detail XHR
capabilities.blocker: The product page hit the traffic/access gate before a product payload was returned. The captured pdp/get_pc response contained no data. The Affiliate productOfferV2 schema exposes a title and image URL only; it does not expose the full description/gallery content. No detail API is claimed.

capabilities.title: Read product options, per-SKU prices, and stock with exact option-to-SKU binding
capabilities.blocker: The gated detail flow emitted no option/SKU request with a product result. Affiliate productOfferV2 provides product-level price/price ranges but no options, SKU prices, or stock. No seller-owned-product API is substituted for marketplace catalog reads.

capabilities.title: Read full review text and traverse review pages using observed pagination fields
capabilities.blocker: The browser was gated before a review section or review XHR was reached, so no review-list path, query contract, body schema, or page cursor was observed. The Affiliate GraphQL schema contains no review body or review pagination fields.

capabilities.title: Read photo URLs attached to individual product reviews
capabilities.blocker: The review UI/API was not reached because the public product detail request was gated. No review-photo field or media request was captured or independently replayed; no guessed endpoint or image URL mapping is implemented.
